# Jono Surname

I am an academic economist specialising in macroeconomics and applied microeconomics. My research interests include monetary policy, labour markets, and the economics of climate risk.

I am currently a Research Economist at Affiliation, and I am available for academic collaboration, policy engagement, and invited seminars.

<p class="keywords"><strong>Research interests</strong> Monetary economics, labour, climate and energy, policy evaluation</p>
